title: LORD, TAKE COMMAND OF THE BATTLES I'M LOSING
text: Beloved, before we go into this sacred moment, I want you to do something for me. Share this prayer with someone. There is a reason you are watching this right now. The Holy Spirit orchestrated this divine appointment. Someone in your family, someone in your workplace, someone in your circle needs to hear what the spirit of God is about to release. Don't keep this to yourself. Share it on your timeline. Send it to that WhatsApp group. Forward it to that friend who has been battling silently. When you share the word of God, you become a partaker of the anointing that follows it. Let somebody else receive their breakthrough through your obedience. Glory to God. Now, lift up your hands wherever you are. Whether you are in your room, in your car, in your office, or in the secret place, lift up your hands to the Lord. This is not just another prayer time. This is a divine encounter. This is a moment of supernatural intervention. The battles you have been losing, the Lord is about to take command. Every struggle that has resisted your efforts, every challenge that has mocked your prayers. Every situation that has defied your faith, the commander of the host of heaven is stepping into the arena this morning. I decree in the name of Jesus, you will not leave this place the same way you came. Somebody shout hallelujah. I speak to you in the name of Jesus. You who have been fighting battles with your strength, you who have been strategizing with human wisdom, you who have been overwhelmed by the magnitude of what you are facing, your season of divine intervention has come. The Bible says in Exodus 14:14, "The Lord shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace. There are battles that are beyond your capacity. There are wars that require divine intervention. There are struggles that will never bow to human effort. And this morning, the spirit of the Lord says, "Step aside. I will take command." I want you to understand something that is fundamental to your breakthrough. There is a difference between God helping you fight and God fighting for you. When God helps you fight, you are still the primary combatant. But when God fights for you, you become a spectator to your own victory. The Red Sea did not open because the children of Israel pushed it. The walls of Jericho did not fall because the children of Israel had military weapons. The host of Midian did not destroy themselves because Gideon was a military genius. In each case, God took command and human effort became irrelevant. So this morning, I am standing in the office of the prophet and I'm decreeing into your life the battles you have been losing, the Lord is taking command. That business that has been collapsing despite your best efforts, the Lord is taking command. That marriage that has been falling apart, despite your prayers, the Lord is taking command. That sickness that has defied medical intervention, the Lord is taking command. That financial crisis that has kept you in perpetual lack, the Lord is taking command. That career that has been stagnant despite your qualifications, the Lord is taking command. I decree it. I establish it. I release it in the name of Jesus. Now, let me show you something from the scriptures in 2 Chronicles chapter 20. There was a moment when Jehoshaphat faced an impossible situation. The Moabites, the Ammonites, and the children of Mount Sia came against him with a great multitude. The Bible says in verse 12, "Oh our God, willil thou not judge them? For we have no might against this great company that cometh against us. Neither know we what to do, but our eyes are upon thee. Listen to the humility in that prayer. We have no might. We don't know what to do, but our eyes are upon you. That is the posture that releases divine intervention. When you come to the end of yourself, when you acknowledge that the battle is beyond you, when you shift your focus from your inadequacy to God's sufficiency, you create a platform for him to take command. The response came in verse 15. Thus sayeth the Lord unto you, be not afraid, nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude. For the battle is not yours, but God's. And the next morning when they went out, they didn't even have to fight. God had already destroyed their enemies. So I am asking you this morning, what is that battle that has made you feel helpless? What is that challenge that has brought you to the end of your wisdom? What is that situation that has made you say, "I don't know what to do anymore." That is the perfect place for divine intervention. Your weakness is the platform for God's strength. Your limitation is the doorway to God's unlimited power. Your helplessness is the invitation for God's help. Lift up your hands and begin to pray. Say, Lord, I acknowledge that I cannot fight this battle with my strength. I cannot win this war with my wisdom. I cannot overcome this challenge with my ability. I am asking you this morning, take command of the battles I am losing. Take command of the situations that have overwhelmed me. Take command of the struggles that have exhausted me. In the name of Jesus, I step aside and I let you fight for me. The tragedy of many believers is that we try to fight spiritual battles with carnal weapons. We try to overcome demonic opposition with human strategies. We try to defeat principalities and powers with our intelligence and connections. But the Bible makes it clear in 2 Corinthians 10:4, for the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds. You cannot fight a spiritual battle with a natural weapon. You cannot overcome a demonic agenda with a human solution. That addiction you have been battling for years. You have tried willpower. You have tried therapy. You have tried accountability partners. And I'm not saying those things are wrong. But if you don't let the Lord take command, you will fight and lose. Fight and lose. Fight and lose. That spirit of poverty that has been following your family for generations. You have tried hard work. You have tried business ideas. You have tried investments. But until the Lord takes command and breaks that generational course, you will labor and achieve nothing. that spirit of marital delay. You have tried dating apps. You have tried matchmakers. You have tried adjusting your standards. But if there is a spiritual blockage, if there is an evil covenant, if there is an ancestral cause until the Lord takes command and destroys it at the root, you will keep experiencing disappointment. Some battles cannot be won with natural effort. Some victories require supernatural intervention. So I am standing in the authority that God has given me and I am decreeing every battle that has been assigned against your life, the Lord is taking command. Every satanic strategy that has been working against your destiny, the Lord is taking command. Every evil altar that has been speaking against your progress, the Lord is taking command. Every demonic covenant that has been operating in your bloodline, the Lord is taking command. I break it. I destroy it. I nullify it in the mighty name of Jesus. Now let me take you to another dimension. In 1st Samuel chapter 17 when David faced Golth, everybody was focused on the size of the giant. Everybody was intimidated by his weapons, his experience, his track record. But David said something profound in verse 47. And all this assembly shall know that the Lord saveth not with sword and spear, for the battle is the Lord's, and he will give you into our hands. David understood a spiritual principle that many of us have not understood. The battle is the Lord's. You see, when you truly understand that the battle is the Lord's, you stop being intimidated by the size of your challenges. You stop being overwhelmed by the track record of your enemies. You stop being discouraged by how many times you have failed because if the battle belongs to God, then the victory belongs to God and he cannot fail. God has never lost a battle. He has never been defeated by any enemy. He has never been outsmarted by any strategy. He has never been overpowered by any force. So when God takes command of your battle, defeat is impossible. When the Lord steps into your situation, failure is not an option. When heaven intervenes in your struggle, the outcome is already determined. I don't care how long that giant has been standing there. I don't care how many people have tried and failed. I don't care what the medical report says. I don't care what the financial statement shows. When the Lord takes command, the story must change. Lift up your voice and begin to declare, "The Lord is taking command of my battles. The Lord is taking command of my life. The Lord is taking command of my destiny. Every giant that has been mocking me, the Lord is taking command. Every stronghold that has been resisting me, the Lord is taking command. Every impossibility that has been confronting me, the Lord is taking command. I decree it, I declare it, I establish it in the name of Jesus. Now, here is what happens when the Lord takes command. First, he exposes the strategies of the enemy. The Bible says in Job 5:12, he disappointed the devices of the crafty so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise. When God takes command, he reveals the hidden plots. He uncovers the secret strategies. He exposes the evil plans. What the enemy thought was hidden, God will bring to light. What the enemy thought was walking in secret, God will expose openly. Second, when the Lord takes command, he releases confusion into the camp of your enemies. In 2 Chronicles 20:23, the Bible says, "For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Sea, utterly to slay and destroy them." And when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Sea, everyone helped to destroy another. God released confusion, and they began to destroy themselves. When the Lord takes command of your battle, your enemies will begin to fight themselves. The people who gathered against you will turn against each other, the strategies designed to destroy you will backfire against those who sent them. Third, when the Lord takes command, he releases unprecedented favor. Esther 8:17 says, "And in every province and in every city, whethersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Jews. For the fear of the Jews fell upon them." When God turned the battle in favor of the Jews, their enemies became afraid, and many even joined them. When God takes command of your situation, the people who rejected you will come looking for you. The doors that were closed against you will open automatically. The opportunities that passed you by will come back looking for you. So I prophesy to you this morning, divine favor is coming upon your life. Supernatural doors are opening for you. Unprecedented opportunities are locating you. People who have power to change your story are being divinely orchestrated to encounter you in the name of Jesus. The Lord is taking command and your season of favor has begun. But let me tell you what is required from your end. You must surrender completely. You cannot ask God to take command while you are still holding on to control. You cannot ask God to fight for you while you are still fighting in your own strength. You cannot ask for divine intervention while you are still relying on human manipulation. Surrender is the key that unlocks divine intervention. Abraham had to surrender Isaac before God could provide. Moses had to surrender his staff before God could perform miracles through it. The widow of Zarapath had to surrender her last meal before God could multiply her supply. The little boy had to surrender his five loaves and two fishes before Jesus could feed 5,000. Surrender is the currency of the supernatural. What you refuse to surrender, God cannot multiply. What you refuse to release, God cannot replenish. So I am asking you this morning, what is God asking you to surrender? Is it that relationship that he has told you to let go? Is it that habit that he has told you to release? Is it that offense that he has told you to forgive? Is it that control that he has told you to relinquish? Until you surrender, God cannot take full command. Partial surrender produces partial intervention. Complete surrender produces complete transformation. Open your mouth right now and pray. Lord, I surrender everything to you. I surrender my will. I surrender my plans. I surrender my agenda. I surrender my timing. I surrender my relationships. I surrender my career. I surrender my finances. I surrender my health. I surrender my past. I surrender my present. I surrender my future. Take command of everything, Lord. Take command of my spirit, soul, and body. Take command of my family. Take command of my destiny. In the name of Jesus, I surrender all. Let me tell you what happens when you truly surrender. The Bible says in Proverbs 3:5 and 6. Trust in the Lord with all thine heart and lean not onto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths. When you stop leaning on your own understanding, when you stop trusting in your own wisdom, when you acknowledge God in everything, he takes responsibility for directing your path. He takes command of where you are going. He takes charge of how you get there. He takes control of who you meet along the way. Now, let me prophesy to you. There is somebody here. You have been battling with a health condition. You have been to hospitals. You have tried medications. You have consulted specialists. But nothing has changed. The spirit of the Lord says to you, the Lord is taking command of your health. That sickness will not kill you. That disease will not destroy you. That condition will not define you. The same God who healed the woman with the issue of blood. The same God who opened blind eyes. The same God who raised the dead is taking command of your body right now. I decree every sickness be healed in the name of Jesus. Every disease be destroyed in the name of Jesus. Every pain be removed in the name of Jesus. Every abnormality in your body return to normal in the name of Jesus. From the crown of your head to the sole of your feet, receive divine health. Receive supernatural healing. Receive creative miracles in the mighty name of Jesus. There is somebody here. You have been struggling financially. You work hard, but you have nothing to show for it. You make money, but it never stays. You have plans, but they never materialize. The spirit of the Lord says to you, the Lord is taking command of your finances. Every hole in your pocket, I seal it in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of poverty, I bind it in the name of Jesus. Every cause of lack, I break it in the name of Jesus. Every evil covenant of failure, I destroy it in the name of Jesus. I decree you will prosper. You will succeed. You will have abundance. You will have overflow. The windows of heaven are opening over your life. The gates of prosperity are swinging open for you. Financial miracles are coming. Business breakthroughs are coming. Job promotions are coming. Divine contracts are coming in the mighty name of Jesus. Receive it. There is somebody here. You have been waiting for the fruit of the womb. Months have turned to years. Years have turned to decades. You have been mocked. You have been pitiful. You have been heartbroken. The spirit of the Lord says to you, the Lord is taking command of your womb. Every spirit of barness, I bind you in the name of Jesus. Every cause of childlessness, I break you in the name of Jesus. Every evil manipulation of your reproductive system, I destroy you in the name of Jesus. I decree you will carry your baby. You will nurse your child. You will raise your seed. The same God who opened Hannah's womb. The same God who blessed Sarah with Isaac. The same God who gave Elizabeth a son in her old age is taking command of your situation right now. Before this year ends, you will conceive. You will carry to full term. You will deliver safely. You will testify in the mighty name of Jesus. Now let me take you deeper. There are some battles you are losing because there are spiritual gates that have not been opened. There are some victories you cannot access because there are heavenly doors that have not been unlocked. There are some blessings you cannot receive because there are divine portals that have not been activated. In Genesis chapter 28 when Jacob had that encounter at Bethl, he said, "This is none other but the house of God and this is the gate of heaven." There are gates in the spirit realm. There are doors in the heavenly places. There are portals that connect the natural with the supernatural. And sometimes the reason you keep losing battles is not because you are not praying, not because you are not fasting, not because you are not giving. It is because there is a gate that is closed, a door that is locked, a portal that is sealed. And until that gate opens, until that door unlocks, until that portal activates, your breakthrough will keep elilluding you. So I am standing in prophetic authority this morning. And I'm commanding every gate that has been shut against you, open in the name of Jesus. Every door that has been locked against your destiny, unlock in the name of Jesus. Every portal that has been sealed against your breakthrough, activate in the name of Jesus. Psalm 24:7 says, "Lift up your heads, oh ye gates, and be ye lift up ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in. I command every ancestral gate to open for you, every generational door to unlock for you, every territorial portal to activate for you. Gates of favor open. Gates of prosperity open. Gates of marriage open. Gates of promotion open. Gates of healing open. Gates of breakthrough open in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree it. I declare it. I establish it. There is a sound that is being released in the spirit realm right now. It is a sound of gates opening. It is a sound of doors unlocking. It is a sound of chains breaking. It is a sound of walls crumbling. It is the sound of barriers collapsing. Can you hear it in the spirit? The Lord is taking command and things are shifting in the heavenly places. Let me tell you what happens when heaven takes command of your battles. Divine alignments begin to happen. People you have never met will become instrumental to your breakthrough. Opportunities you never applied for will locate you. Resources you never worked for will come to you. The Bible says in Deuteronomy 28:2, "And all these blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God." When God takes command, blessings don't just come, they overtake you. They chase you down. They catch up with you. They overwhelm you. You won't have to struggle for them. You won't have to manipulate for them. You won't have to compromise for them. They will come looking for you. I prophesy divine speed is coming upon your life. What should take 10 years will happen in 10 months. What should take 10 months will happen in 10 weeks. What should take 10 weeks will happen in 10 days. The Lord is taking command and acceleration is your portion. Now let me give you a practical instruction. For the next seven days I want you to do something. Every morning before you do anything else I want you to declare Lord take command of this day. Take command of my steps. Take command of my decisions. Take command of my conversations. Take command of my thoughts. Take command of my actions. In the name of Jesus, I surrender this day to you. When you start your day by surrendering to God, you give him legal authority to direct everything that happens in that day. You give him permission to orchestrate divine encounters. You give him access to rearrange circumstances in your favor. You activate the supernatural over your natural activities. Don't just pray and ask God to bless what you have already planned. Surrender your plans to him first and let him take command of your day. And at night before you sleep, I want you to declare, "Lord, I thank you for taking command of this day. As I sleep tonight, take command of my dreams. Take command of my spirit while my body rests. Let no evil spirit visit me. Let no witchcraft attack me. Let no bad dream disturb me in the name of Jesus. I cover myself with the blood of Jesus. And I command angelic protection over my life. The battle is not just in the day. Sometimes the most critical battles happen at night. Sometimes the enemy attacks you in your dreams. Sometimes evil altars manipulate you in the spirit realm while you are sleeping. But when you consciously surrender your nights to God, when you command him to take charge even while you sleep, you create a shield of protection that the enemy cannot penetrate. I want to tell you something that will change your prayer life. Prayer is not just about talking to God. It is about positioning yourself for God to take command. Prayer is not about convincing God to do what you want. It is about aligning yourself with what God wants. Prayer is not about changing God's mind. It is about changing your position so that God can move on your behalf. When you pray, Lord take command, you are not giving God information. He already knows everything. You are giving God permission. You are giving God authorization. You are giving God legal access. Because God is a God of order. He operates by spiritual laws. And one of those spiritual laws is the law of invitation. God will not force himself into your situation. He waits to be invited. He waits to be acknowledged. He waits to be surrendered to. So every time you pray, Lord, take command. You are opening a door in the spirit realm. You are activating a divine protocol. You are releasing a heavenly mechanism. And the angels that are assigned to your life receive instruction to move. The forces of darkness that are assigned against you receive a notice of eviction. The principalities and powers that are monitoring your destiny, receive a restraining order from heaven. Lift up your hands right now and begin to pray with aggression. This is not the time for gentle prayers. This is not the time for passive declarations. This is a time for militant intercession. Open your mouth and command. Every power that is resisting my breakthrough, the Lord is taking command of you. Every spirit that is fighting my destiny, the Lord is taking command of you. Every demon that is monitoring my progress, the Lord is taking command of you. I command you to bow in the name of Jesus. I command you to surrender in the name of Jesus. I command you to release me in the name of Jesus. Let me prophesy to you. Before this month ends, you will have a testimony. Before this quarter ends, you will see the hand of God move in your situation. Before this year ends, you will look back and say, "God truly took command of my battles." The things you are struggling with today will become your testimony tomorrow. The battles you are losing today will become your victory songs tomorrow. The challenges you are facing today will become your miracles tomorrow. I see it in the spirit. I see doors opening. I see walls falling. I see chains breaking. I see captives being set free. I see the sick being healed. I see the barren conceiving. I see the poor becoming rich. I see the rejected being celebrated. I see the forgotten being remembered. I see the overlooked being promoted. The Lord is taking command and your season has changed. Now receive this prophetic word. Every battle you thought you had lost, the Lord is reversing it. Every ground the enemy thought he had gained in your life, the Lord is recovering it. Every blessing the enemy thought he had stolen from you, the Lord is restoring it. Joel 2:2 says, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten, the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palmer worm, my great army, which I sent among you." Whatever the enemy has eaten in your life, God is restoring it. Whatever the enemy has stolen from you, God is recovering it. Whatever the enemy has destroyed in your family, God is rebuilding it. The Lord is taking command and restoration is your portion.
